product_overview: Hard Challenge is a bilingual habit-building and self-discipline app that helps users complete daily challenges, earn XP and points, and track their progress over time. It also includes gamified features like rewards, achievements, leaderboards, and story mode, with mobile-first support for Android and PWA installs.
core_goals: Complete daily challenge tasks to earn XP
Create and manage personal tasks, habits, and reminders
Track progress, points, achievements, and rankings
Customize the app experience with language and theme settings
Access install instructions for the PWA and handle unknown routes gracefully

features.name: Welcome and Authentication
features.description: Users can open the welcome screen, switch between sign-up and sign-in, return to the welcome view, and submit Clerk authentication forms in Arabic or English.
user_flows: Navigate to /auth -> See the welcome screen with branding and call-to-action options -> Choose to get started -> Open the sign-up form -> Fill in email and password -> Submit the form -> Reach the CAPTCHA step
Navigate to /auth -> Choose that they already have an account -> Open the sign-in form -> Fill in email and password -> Submit the form -> Continue into the authenticated experience
Navigate to /auth -> Open the sign-up or sign-in form -> Use the back button -> Return to the welcome screen

Navigate to /auth -> Switch the language from the globe control -> See the page reload with updated text direction and translated content -> Continue using the authentication view in the selected language
Navigate to /auth?ref=CODE -> Skip the welcome screen -> Open the sign-up form with the referral already stored for later use

features.name: Language switching (i18n)
features.description: Users can switch the app between Arabic RTL and English LTR, with the chosen language persisted for future visits.
user_flows: Navigate to /auth -> Open the language selector -> Choose Arabic -> See the interface reload in RTL layout with Arabic text
Navigate to /auth -> Open the language selector -> Choose English -> See the interface reload in LTR layout with English text
Navigate to /settings -> Open the language setting -> Choose a different language -> See the app reload with the new language applied

features.name: Daily challenge home
features.description: Authenticated users can view today's tasks, complete them for XP, and go through the first-login onboarding experience.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> See today's daily challenge tasks -> Complete a task -> See progress and XP update
Navigate to / -> On first login, see the onboarding carousel -> Swipe through the onboarding steps -> Enter profile details such as name, age, and gender -> Continue to the home view
Navigate to / -> Open the navigation menu -> Move to another section of the app

features.name: Tasks, paths, calendar, and reminders
features.description: Users can create tasks and custom habits, browse learning paths and their tasks, view scheduled progress on a calendar, and set reminder times.
user_flows: Navigate to /create-task -> Enter a task title and schedule -> Save the task -> Return to the task management experience
Navigate to /custom-habit -> Enter habit details -> Save the custom habit -> See it added for future tracking
Navigate to /paths -> Browse available paths -> Open one path -> View the tasks inside that path
Navigate to /calendar -> Review tasks and progress across dates -> Inspect upcoming and completed activity
Navigate to /reminders -> Set a reminder time -> Save the reminder -> See the reminder listed for the task

features.name: Gamification: points, rewards, achievements, stores, leaderboards, and story mode
features.description: Users can monitor their points, redeem rewards, view achievements, buy items in stores, compare rankings on leaderboards, and access special gamified modes.
user_flows: Navigate to /points -> View the current points balance and history -> Review how points have been earned
Navigate to /rewards -> Browse available rewards -> Redeem a reward with available points -> See the reward marked as claimed
Navigate to /achievements -> View unlocked badges and progress toward remaining achievements
Navigate to /leaderboard -> Compare rankings against other users -> Review position and score details
Navigate to /store -> Browse purchasable items -> Buy an item with points -> See the item added to the account
Navigate to /story-mode -> Enter the story mode experience -> Interact with the gamified mini-game experience

features.name: Profile, settings, backups, gallery, and admin
features.description: Users can view and edit profile details, change app settings, back up or restore data, browse a gallery, and access restricted admin functions when permitted.
user_flows: Navigate to /profile -> Review personal stats and account information -> Edit profile details -> Save the updates
Navigate to /settings -> Change app preferences such as language or theme -> Save the selection -> See the updated app appearance
Navigate to /backups -> Trigger a backup or restore action -> Confirm the data management action -> Return with data preserved or restored
Navigate to /gallery -> Browse stored photos in the gallery -> Open an image for viewing
Navigate to /admin -> View the admin panel when authorized -> Use the restricted administration tools

features.name: PWA install instructions
features.description: Visitors can open the install page to learn how to install the app as a PWA on their device.
user_flows: Navigate to /install -> Read the installation instructions -> Use the back navigation to return to the app

features.name: 404 not found
features.description: Unknown URLs show a not found page for invalid routes.
user_flows: Navigate to an unknown route -> See the 404 not found page -> Use available navigation to recover

tech_stack: i18next (Arabic RTL / English LTR, full reload on switch)

routes.description: Welcome screen (brand, hero, GET STARTED + I ALREADY HAVE AN ACCOUNT buttons). ?mode=signin shows Clerk sign-in form, ?mode=signup (or ?ref=) shows Clerk sign-up form. Language switcher (ar/en) in the corner.
Home page with daily challenge tasks; redirects to /auth when signed out; shows onboarding carousel on first login; may redirect NASS users to /nass

features.name: Welcome and Authentication
features.description: Welcome screen styled like an onboarding page; Clerk-hosted sign-in/sign-up forms with Arabic/English localization; referral (?ref=) and company (?company=) codes stored in localStorage for post-signup consumption
user_interactions: See welcome screen with brand logo, hero image, headline
Click GET STARTED to open sign-up form
Click I ALREADY HAVE AN ACCOUNT to open sign-in form
Click back arrow to return to welcome view
Switch language between Arabic (RTL) and English (LTR) via the globe button
Fill email and password and submit (Clerk handles verification)

features.name: Language switching (i18n)
features.description: Arabic RTL and English LTR; switch triggers document.dir change and full page reload; persisted in localStorage 'language'
user_interactions: Click globe icon and pick language
Page reloads with new direction and translated texts

features.name: Theme (dark/light + color packs)
features.description: Class-based dark mode with system default; purchasable theme color packs override CSS variables from localStorage
user_interactions: Toggle dark/light mode in settings
Apply a theme pack from the theme store

features.name: Daily challenge home
features.description: Daily task list with XP, streaks, splash screen on launch, first-login onboarding carousel, offline indicator
user_interactions: Complete/uncheck daily tasks
Swipe through onboarding on first login and enter name/age/gender
Navigate to other sections via menu

features.name: Tasks, paths, calendar, reminders
features.description: Create tasks/custom habits, browse paths and their tasks, calendar overview, local notification reminders
user_interactions: Create a task with title/schedule
Open a path and view its tasks
Browse calendar
Set a reminder time

features.name: Gamification (points, rewards, achievements, stores, leaderboards, story mode)
features.description: XP and points economy, rewards catalog, achievements, in-app store, theme store, global and NASS leaderboards, story mode mini-game
user_interactions: View points balance and history
Redeem rewards
View achievements and leaderboard rankings
Buy store items with points

features.name: Profile, settings, backups, gallery, admin
features.description: Profile stats, app settings, data backup/restore, photo gallery, admin panel
user_interactions: Edit profile details
Change settings (language, theme, notifications)
Trigger backup or restore

known_limitations.issue: No test account available; Clerk bot protection (Cloudflare Turnstile CAPTCHA) blocks automated sign-up
known_limitations.impact: All auth_required routes redirect to /auth when signed out, so only public flows (welcome, sign-in/sign-up forms UI, language switch, install page, 404) can be tested end-to-end

known_limitations.issue: Mobile-first Capacitor app; some features (local notifications, haptics) are no-ops in desktop browsers
known_limitations.impact: Reminder scheduling cannot be fully verified in a web browser

known_limitations.issue: Splash screen animation plays ~3 seconds on every page load before content is interactive
known_limitations.impact: Tests must wait for the splash to fade before interacting
